snippet.title: Mouthwashing Console Announcement | CRTime
snippet.description:
It’s finally time to get back aboard the Tulpar.
Mouthwashing is coming to XBOX Game Pass, XBOX on PC, XBOX Series X|S, PLAYSTATION 5
PLAYSTATION 4, NINTENDO SWITCH 1 on October 29th.
Five crew members. A shipwrecked freighter. No way home.

Take Responsibility on Steam Now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2475490/Mouthwashing/
